snippet.title: Raspberry Pi PCIe Shenanigans: Using Pi 5 in all the wrong ways!
snippet.description:
What happens when you plug a GPU into a Pi 5? How about WiFi 7? And three Xeon CPUs... wait, what?!

Please consider donating to the UOAA to support other people with ostomies, like I have! You can use the form on YouTube next to this video, or donate online:

https://www.ostomy.org/donate/

For more of my wild Pi PCIe shenanigans, check out my Pi PCIe website: https://pipci.jeffgeerling.com

Here are all the devices I used in the livestream (some are affiliate links):

  - Pineboards HATs: https://pineboards.io
  - Lian-Li SP 750 SFX PSU: https://amzn.to/4eIzzsu
  - JMT M.2 to Oculink PCIe Dock: https://amzn.to/3BBQkHG
  - SFF-8611 OCuLink PCIe Gen 4 Cable: https://amzn.to/4eQtxGm
  - IO CREST M.2 PCIe 5 Gbps NIC: https://amzn.to/47SyuMz
  - OCP-TAP PCIe2HAT: https://github.com/geerlingguy/raspberry-pi-pcie-devices/issues/663

Support me on Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/geerlingguy
Sponsor me on GitHub: https://github.com/sponsors/geerlingguy
Merch: https://www.redshirtjeff.com
